To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the angular fractional depth of a road centerline is a measure of the complexity of the urban road network, and that the angular fractional depths of a city’s road network are correlated with the city’s population size, and the city’s area.
angular integration analysis is useful to describe the urban layout in GIS road centerline data.

angular integration analysis of GIS data representing urban layouts can be extended to describe the spatial structure of urban layouts based on weighted integration analysis, and that the resulting spatial structure of urban layout can be described by a single parameter.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following: (1) the definition of a set of rules for the description of urban layouts in GIS road centerline databases, (2) the development of algorithms for the syntactic analysis of road centerline data based on the angular fractional depth concept and (3) the implementation of these algorithms in a GIS software system.
the development and implementation of an angular integration analysis method to characterize urban layouts based on GIS road-centerline databases.
the development of a new approach to the description of urban layouts based on road centerlines.

the angular fractional depth is a powerful tool for the description of urban road centerline data.
the angular fractional depth is a useful tool for the description and analysis of GIS road-center-line data for large scale analysis of urban layouts.
the angular fractional depth of road centerlines can be used as a tool in GIS analysis to describe the layout of road networks in urban areas.

we have developed a methodology that can be used to describe urban form in terms of a series of angular measures, and that these measures can be used to characterize urban form and to compare different urban forms.
the weighted angular integration (WAI) analysis of road-centerline GIS data can provide an effective means for the description of large scale urban layouts.
the angular fractional depth is a useful tool to describe urban layouts.
